basis: Pursuant to the Civil Code No. 91/2015/QH13;
Pursuant to the Law on Commerce No. 36/2005/QH11;
Pursuant to the Law on Electronic Transactions No. 20/2023/QH15;
Pursuant to the needs and capacity of the parties.
intro: The parties agree on the following terms and execution order.

sections.title: Parties and purpose
sections.body: Buyer: {buyer}. Supplier: {supplier}. Reference: {code}. This test fixture reflects the form and is not legal advice.

sections.title: Scope of work
sections.body: The supplier delivers the work described by the contract title and its milestones. Evidence must belong to this contract and the correct event type.

sections.title: Contract value
sections.body: Contract value: {valueMillion} million VND, including value added tax (VAT) and every cost of completing the work. It is paid by the milestones of Article 4; the milestone amounts add up to the contract value.

sections.title: Milestones and payment
sections.body: The milestones below come from the workflow of the contract type; due dates are spread over the contract period and the last falls on the end date. A reviewer compares and confirms them before signing. A milestone is paid only when every document in the "Required evidence" column is provided by the side shown in brackets.

sections.title: Acceptance evidence
sections.body: Each document is an electronic file submitted and signed by the party responsible for it. An invoice is an electronic invoice under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC stating its symbol, number, issue date, seller tax code and a total equal to the milestone amount; it is issued no earlier than signing and backs one milestone only. The buyer checks, asks for more or confirms acceptance in writing.

sections.title: Approval policy
sections.body: Approval policy: {approvalPolicyText}. A milestone is paid only when its documents under Article 4 are complete, the approvals of this policy are given and no dispute about it is open. Signing the contract does not replace checking documents and approving payment.

sections.title: Signers and order
sections.body: Signers act in the order shown below. The final step requires digital signing. The same person cannot occupy two steps.

sections.title: Late penalty and grace
sections.body: Start date: {startDate}. End date: {endDate}. Grace period: {graceDays} days. Penalty rate: {penaltyRatePct}% per day. A milestone marked for penalty in Article 4 completed after its due date plus the grace period is charged this rate on the milestone amount for each day late. Completion is the date of the last valid document. The penalty is deducted from that milestone's payment.

sections.title: Liability cap
sections.body: Penalty cap: {maxPenaltyPct}%. Total late penalties stay within the agreed cap and within 8% of the value of the breached obligation (Law on Commerce 2005, Article 301). The engine uses exact decimal formulas and records decision reasons in the audit trail.

sections.title: Warranty and support
sections.body: The supplier handles support requests and the warranty within the scope of work. The warranty milestone completes with the document confirming the warranty is complete; when the contract states only a relative warranty term, the parties confirm the exact date during review.

sections.title: Disputes
sections.body: An open dispute holds release. The controller handles exceptions; system administration does not confer business approval authority. Disputes not settled by negotiation go to the competent court.

sections.title: Change control
sections.body: Changes to scope, value or schedule are made by an amendment. A schedule amendment (milestone due dates, end date) is proposed by the buyer with its reason and takes effect only when the supplier accepts it; a milestone whose payment is decided keeps its due date. The signed terms stay unchanged; amendments are kept with the contract.

sections.title: Effect and retention
sections.body: The contract becomes effective when all configured signing steps complete. When every milestone is paid or closed, the parties sign a liquidation record and no further documents or payments arise. This fixture is unsigned; demo LOCAL_ED25519 proof is not an externally trusted CA/PAdES certificate.

single: Single signer: this signature completes the configured signing workflow.
multiple: Multiple signers: all steps must complete in order, representing both parties.
review: Review the entire document before signing. The blank areas below are reserved for signatures; signer identity and time are retained with the record.
signatureNote: (Sign, write full name and affix seal)

original.notice: Simulated contract, rebuilt from the organiser's contract data for viewing and cross-checking
original.closing: The contract becomes effective when all agreed signing steps complete. The parties keep the original and its records. This copy is rebuilt from the contract data for viewing in the system. When every milestone is paid or closed, the parties sign a liquidation record.

pendingSigners: Signers have not been chosen yet: the signing list and order will appear here once signers are selected.

approvalPolicies.AUTO_IF_ALL_CONDITIONS: paid automatically when the conditions hold, no approval
approvalPolicies.SINGLE_BUYER_APPROVAL: approved by the buyer's contract owner
approvalPolicies.DUAL_APPROVAL: approved together by the buyer's contract owner and secondary approver
approvalPolicies.FINANCE_PLUS_OWNER: approved together by the buyer's finance approver and contract owner

approvalExempt: These milestones need no approval and are paid when their documents are complete and no dispute is open: {milestones}.
scheduleNote: Each milestone amount is its share of the contract value, rounded down to 0.01 million; the last milestone takes the remainder so the amounts add up to the contract value.
